contractBoundary.role: Logical mapping and typed profile registry; not a replacement for native SDK schemas or an implemented adapter.
contractBoundary.fieldHintSemantics: observedFields are conservative type hints for known native members or explicitly noted normalized envelopes. Absence remains absent; these hints do not invent native requiredness or coerce unknown values.
contractBoundary.rawPayloadPolicy: Retain exact source JSON/envelope, including unknown members, enums, unions, scalars and null. Projection failure records a diagnostic and preserves source evidence.
contractBoundary.unknownProfilePolicy: Retain raw SourceRevision with unsupported-profile state; do not invent a normalized result or silently drop it.
contractBoundary.sourceIdentityPolicy: Native identity uses owning provider tuple and parent scope, never Connection credentials or display names. Canonical-to-provider bindings require evidence.
contractBoundary.writePolicy: Profile descriptors do not authorize native writes. Phase 1 includes specifications only; commands that reach AWS need a separately implemented, authorized, idempotency-aware adapter.
contractBoundary.projectionPolicy: Only normalizedBinding.projectionProfile names are ProjectionRevision enum values. Other console profiles bind SourceRevision.profile as LOCAL_EVIDENCE captures or declared owned values; they do not invent unmodeled normalized projection variants.

mappings.preservedSemantics: Keep the full provider event ARN. Event counts do not multiply by context, receipt, or delivery.
Catalog classification is observed evidence; it cannot overwrite the classification actually reported on an event.
Unique workspace/event/kind/non-null contextKey. PUBLIC has no affected-account or organization link; ACCOUNT has exactly one account; ORG_SUMMARY has exactly one organization and owns no impacts.
Pin contextual source evidence and field presence. Summary absence does not erase hydrated detail. Event status, provider time and local observation time remain separate.
Locale and text belong to the exact event-context revision. The latest-description API does not provide an independent provider history entity.
An event-relative construct may be a resource, group or broader marker. Preserve provisional local ID and optional Health entity ARN. Supplied account must agree with ACCOUNT context.
Entity provider-update time is independent of parent event time; repeat reads do not create another impact.
Preserve partition and string account ID. Names and ownership are external enrichment; receipt is not impact or membership evidence.
Preserve external organization identity and scope; Health does not return a complete organization directory.
Time-bounded account/organization relation with source evidence. Historical visibility can outlast current membership.
Observed integration state differs from requested state and backfill completeness; an empty enable/disable acknowledgement proves neither readiness nor coverage.
Zero, one or several verified resource matches, each with method, confidence and exact evidence. Unresolved values and groups remain valid.
Local communication identity differs from raw AWS communicationId. Preserve notification-account context, grouping method, expected pages, conflicts and assembly state.
Preserve exact raw communicationId and page number. Group a page suffix only when validated; require expected pages before claiming complete membership.
Raw envelope is an exact SourceRevision; Observation records receipt. Logical page dedupe excludes backup delivery region/envelope ID; receipt metadata never becomes affected-account attribution.
A collection/access path with capabilities, authorization context and monitored scope. Changing role/connection does not change native identity.
A bounded collection owns attempts for each operation/page, including empty successes and failures; pagination completion applies only to that query.
Retain event/account-specific failedSet errors even when transport status is 200. Batch success is not inferred from HTTP status.
Pin query scope, page chain, errors, unavailable capabilities, freshness and policy. A snapshot freezes these values; later collection cannot improve old coverage.
SourceRevision preserves exact payload; Observation records seeing it. API, EventBridge and operator channels retain their own receipt kinds.
Retain query, requested breakdown, counting unit, time and completeness. An omitted account breakdown is not zero affected accounts.
Use stable local identity and retained source revisions; service/version is not a provider-guaranteed unique key. Preserve unresolved recommendedVersion.
Owner-local milestone identity/order, explicit date/type/risks/regions and exact entry revision. A new date does not erase prior history; missing regions is not all regions.
Inventory identity is external and independent of Health entity identity. Resolve by qualified evidence, never name alone.
One observed resource component/version and its exact source/time. A resource can host multiple components; current inventory is not historical inventory.
Pin deployment evidence and milestone revision. Record applicability, method, confidence, rule version and cutoff; ambiguous/no match remains unknown.
Local owner/priority/due/workflow, independent verification state/evidence and concurrency version; completing work never changes provider entity state or independently observed deployment.
Each target is exactly one typed context, impact or exposure reference. Several targets can coordinate one item without inventing a provider incident-group ID.
Append actor/time/action/evidence and local version under the work aggregate; retain source statements for provenance. An action audit is not provider success.
Summary/detail wrappers represent existing event/context identities; representation and present fields remain explicit.
Provider batch errors retain exact shape/code and scoped item references. Do not fabricate missing successful items.
These are request/cursor values, not operational identities. Save exact effective query; keep native tokens opaque and separate from application cursors.
Partition/owning account/Region plus service-specific parent scope. Unambiguously encode opaque IDs; connection role is not native identity.
Separate access/caching/export scope from source ownership. Current authorization still applies to historical data.
Scoped native Agent Space; it is not the console Workspace. Retain ARN aliases when supplied.
An integration registration is not a workload Service. Built-in serviceId aws need not resolve to one; preserve independent native identity.
Own association ID/configuration discriminator and optional registration resolution. Do not require serviceId uniqueness within a space.
Keep system/referenceId/URL/associationId and unresolved historical association; an external alert/ticket is not replaced by task linking.
INVESTIGATION task type projects to Investigation. Preserve task priority/type/status/version and scoped task ID. Other native task types remain typed task DTOs.
Explicit link observed from task-scoped ListExecutions request. Execution has no native taskId; allow multiple observed memberships and deduplicate repeated membership evidence.
Scoped execution identity; explicit parent can remain unresolved. Task.executionId is a pointer, not proof of latest/root/only run. STOPPED is preserved.
Scoped space/execution/record ID, open recordType, createdAt and arbitrary JSON content. Preserve unknown types/scalars/null.
Logical source identity plus exact payload hash under declared canonicalization. A revision is locally retained, not a claimed native Journal revision API.
Stable, collision-free owning tuple/channel/native key is carried by revisions. It does not require a new mutable aggregate or generic entity database.

Exact revision plus typed locator and citation identity. Multiple locators into one revision are distinct citations; preserve JSON pointer, source/path and content-range meaning without replacing the pinned revision.

Stable logical item identity and separate immutable rendition ID/hash. Preserve payload kind, assertion origin and exact derivation. The five normalized profiles use ProjectionRevision; other previous typed renditions retain original logical/revision IDs, payload and derivation as application-origin SourceRevision evidence.
Parser/rule/model versions and deterministic policy are retained with the result; a parser upgrade cannot rewrite an old snapshot.
One bounded query-set reconciliation with target, collector/version, selection policy and capture window.

Every operation/page attempt has identity, exact query, pagination, times, outcome and native diagnostics, including empty successes and failures. requestSourceRevisionId pins the retained request; responseSourceRevisionId pins its envelope when available, including empty successful responses. A lost response remains null, not an invented empty success.
Repeat receipt of unchanged content adds observation history without creating new logical records or revisions. Non-read channels do not invent ReadAttempts.
Named query-set/pass, scope, as-of, page/attempt evidence, bounds, outcome and rule version; exhaustion is not an AWS finalization barrier.

Independent evidence/record/receipt clocks with basis, phase, provenance, availability and stable local ordering. No invented agent progress percentage. Retain the previous typed analysis rendition as application-origin evidence; a dedicated normalized projection variant is a future schema extension.

Typed attributed findings/evidence/hypotheses/causal claims/proposals/reviews, each with exact source and derivation. These are not native Resilience Finding identities or recovered private reasoning. Retain the previous typed analysis rendition as application-origin evidence; a dedicated normalized projection variant is a future schema extension.

Request, decision, resume, execution and effect are independently sourced stages. Approval or credential redemption never proves success. Retain the previous typed analysis rendition as application-origin evidence; a dedicated normalized projection variant is a future schema extension.
Select per investigation/mitigation phase by exact completion pointer when present; preserve missing-pointer, no-summary-reported and unavailable-reference states.
Explicit namespace/ID/URL and resolution provenance. A connection, same-space location or temporal adjacency is not implication or consumption evidence.
Preserve channel, exact locator, optional asset/version, availability, type, digest and authorization. A2A and journal IDs never become native asset IDs.
Named graph kind and immutable rendition; snapshots pin nodes/edges and source revisions, not an unversioned graph.
Unique within graph rendition, with node kind/exact source and optional resolved resource; explicit stub for unresolved endpoints.
Both endpoints belong to the same graph snapshot. Keep relation type/assertion origin; execution parentage or temporal precedence is not causality.
Space-scoped native asset and open type. Same Agent Space does not imply that a task used or produced it.
Exact asset ID/native version + observed metadata/content revisions. Requested attachment IDs do not establish consumed version.
Exact asset version and path; preserve bytes/text representation and content digest. A file version is an asset version, not a separate invented native counter.

Immutable capture manifest with task/membership/results/sources/projections, frozen coverage and explicit captureStartedAt/captureFinishedAt. capturedAt does not replace these boundaries or provider times. A later continued investigation creates new evidence.
Exact source revisions plus captured attempt/page/coverage evidence. A later successful refresh cannot improve captured coverage.

Exact projectionRevisionId/hash. Authorized retained content opens independently of live refresh; comparison has its own availability. Imported legacy renditions outside the five normalized profiles are pinned in sourceRevisionIds with their original revision identity and derivation retained.
Preserve native content unions, session scope, queue versus history distinction and attribution. Chat response completion is not task completion.
Only supplied userId/userType are facts; absent user data is unknown and uid alone is session identity.
Own response/session/block identities and sequence when supplied; preserve partial JSON, gaps and unknown branches. Stream cursor/parentage is not durable Journal identity.
Observed chat request with space-scoped approvalId, execution/interrupt/toolUse IDs and exact requested pattern. Do not synthesize from waiting status or prose.
Keep typed pins and exact IDs. Finalized scope may match or narrow requested scope, never widen it; decision and resume are separate.
Distinct decision command/audit with payload hash, actor and definitive/ambiguous outcome. Native UpdateApprovalAction has no modeled token/readback operation.
Separate command related to accepted decision. Stream-open does not prove resumed effect; lost-response uncertainty never triggers a blind mutating retry.
Keep genuine space-scoped goal identity, lifecycle/version, typed content and scheduling/last-task relations. It is not a Scenario or an investigation completion.
Keep native recommendationId/taskId and optional goal/version with its own lifecycle and priority. Native identity is distinct from observation-scoped Resilience suggested changes.
Separate native automation resource with schedule union/open action; not an Asset or executable console ScenarioRevision. Current custom-agent links are not historical consumption.
Provider access configuration belongs to its Agent Space; it is not console authentication or investigation fact.
Keep provider name/ARN/network/certificate/state; it is not the console Connection access path.
Provider intake descriptor scoped to its association; configuration does not prove receipt of any incident/event.
Scoped usage-window metrics and limits; not incident telemetry, runtime success, or task recovery.
Keep provider filter combinations and exact order; a task leaving a filtered page is not deletion. No generic updated-since feed is implied.
Preserve type catalog, source URL and text/bytes/ZIP members. GetAssetContent carries ZIP bytes in JSON content.zipFile; native/upload limits remain adapter-specific.
Known typed provider unions with raw unknown variants retained. Strict native write validation is separate from tolerant output ingestion.
Scoped native mutable template; pin observed configuration. It is not a ScenarioRevision; no provider revision guarantee is invented.
Native catalog identity and retrieval revision. A catalog action ID does not identify each named runtime use.
Catalog-action parameter map key with supplied description/requiredness. Units/types/defaults require separately sourced adapter metadata.
Catalog action plus slot name and supported resource type. Preserve slot identity through template/runtime bindings.
Open provider resource-type identity and typed metadata; resolve actual resources only through a type-specific adapter.
Template-scoped action name, actionId and parameters. Two names using one actionId remain two definitions.
Template-scoped selector definition; retain selection mode, parameters, filters and tags as supplied.
Action/slot references a named selector within the same template.
Named predecessor/successor edge within one template DAG; keep separate from console workflow dependencies.
Template/account identity with role/reference metadata. Current template configuration cannot rewrite prior experiments.
Scoped native experiment identity with frozen run configuration. May exist without a console Run; a StepAttempt can explicitly refer to it.
Experiment/action-name identity, raw state/reason/times and parameters. No independent stop/retry/pause operation is implied.
Same-experiment named-action DAG from runtime evidence, independent of product StepRuns.
Exact runtime selector snapshot; never read current template to reconstruct historical target intent.
Action-name/slot-to-selector link with owning experiment scope.
Run-scoped account configuration observation. Account inclusion alone creates neither child experiment nor per-account success.
Keep every selector membership and complete targetInformation. Deduplicate established Resource identity separately from membership.
Qualified type/account/Region/native key and match provenance. EKS pod scope includes cluster/namespace/name; container selection remains membership detail.
Resolution-ended evidence and exhausted page traversal are independent. A complete empty page does not by itself establish empty resolved scope.
Exact source record/location with action/selector/account associations; top-level FIS log id is experiment ID, not an event ID.
Preserve raw provider status, source timestamp and observation/capture interval; receipt order does not establish lifecycle order.
Report generation/readiness is independent of experiment execution and assessment. Eligibility/configuration presence and retrieval errors remain explicit.
Exact artifact descriptor/ARN/type and version/digest when known; access is authorized separately, and presence does not imply evaluation success.
Source/value retained; source=none is an explicit marker and creates no alarm reference.
Qualified external alarm identity. Alarm state/history is separately observed evidence, not an experiment aggregate.
Exact state/transition with source/time/coverage; experiment termination cannot fabricate an alarm transition.
Partition/account/Region is a provider ownership value, not tenant identity or a credential grant.
Scoped native safety control; unknown hydration does not remove the native one-per-supported-scope relation. Writes remain explicit future adapter commands.
Versioned metric/query definition with dimensions, units, aggregation, period/windows/normalizer and source.
Exact binding revision and experiment/window use. It does not duplicate the metric definition or invent native linkage.
Typed samples with query/unit/window/coverage. Missing sample is not zero and prose is not a numeric series.
Immutable evaluator/predicate/threshold/unit/denominator semantics pinned with the revision or read-only reassessment specification.

Local immutable evaluation, not native ResilienceAssessment. New evidence/rule/cutoff creates another EVALUATION revision over a frozen input Snapshot; an orchestration Run is optional. Preserve every historical assessment of an experiment.
Exact accepted source revisions/observations and evaluation cutoff, scoped to the Run through retained/imported references.
Mutable catalog metadata/default revision/archive under an explicit version; names and digests are not identity.
Immutable program with locked operation/schema/implementation/runtime/time/reducer versions. Mutable authoring aliases cannot change a published revision.
Exactly one published revision/admission snapshot. Separate execution phase/outcome, check verdict, and finalization/unresolved effects.
One per compiled main or finalizer step, including zero-attempt skipped steps. Canonical ID adds convenience; unique (runId,stepKey) remains.
Unique (stepRunId,attemptNo), durable dispatch/effect intent, evidence and checkpoints. Poll/resume does not create a new attempt; ambiguous effects fence retries.

Replace run-only Evidence root with immutable payload revision + receipt/import occurrence. Run owns an immutable evidence-reference manifest; producer/import origin and same-run citation authorization remain explicit.
Revision-local stepKey with operation binding, inputs, dependencies, timeout/retry/check role and main/finalizer graph phase.
Exact implementation/input/output schema digests and contract version; unavailable/revoked pin rejects execution without silent substitution.
Exact revision, validated inputs, authorized resource/connection bindings and observed versions, enabled steps, required-criterion denominator and effective policy.
Qualified external references; inventory and credentials remain separate. Resolving a reference never grants permission.
Sealed verdict/reason, evaluator digest, actual/expected values, evidence refs and evaluation cutoff. False predicate is not technical failure.
The source workflow uses Observation for evidence content. Consolidated Observation names receipt identity; payload kind/coverage remains typed on the retained evidence profile.
Qualified provider handle plus stable originEffectKey even before remote ID is known. Native Experiment and logs query IDs are references, not a new generic Run.
First accepted principal/time/reason is monotonic, fences new main dispatch, and is independent of confirmed remote stop or cleanup.
Store locator/version/media/length/digest; temporary download URL and access rights resolve separately.
Typed technical failure with safe diagnostics. Assessment false, transport failure and unresolved side effect have different meanings.
Capture handle is an external-operation reference; registry locks and reducer/denominator/finalization values belong to revision/run ownership, not extra CRUD roots.
Console System owns local catalog metadata; verified native ARN/ID is an alias/import fact. ARN-less summaries retain unresolved partial identity, not a fabricated ARN.
One local Service membership authority, with provenance for imported native associatedSystems. Shared services deduplicate by canonical/provider identity, not path count.
Belongs to one System; provider identity includes parent system scope. Local catalog changes never silently update native journey configuration.
Selected journey belongs to the same associated System; derive journey service list from Service membership rather than two writable authorities.
Console business service has opaque canonical identity and local configuration. Native ARN/configuration is an imported facet, not the universal service primary key.
Qualified policy identity with immutable source revisions; direct service/journey assignment stays explicit and no native system policy is invented.
Four typed native components: availabilitySlo, dataRecovery, multiAz, multiRegion. Local performance objectives require a separate namespace and units.
Exact observed target bundle with original source/time; do not independently select latest values when displaying an older posture context.
Typed value/unit plus optional policy name and ownership. Name is not policy identity; SELF/CROSS_ACCOUNT is not DIRECT/INHERITED.
Immutable assignment/membership/policy hashes and exact effective-target source revision; observed context does not prove which policy revision AWS evaluated.
Native service/assessment identity. Execution SUCCESS is distinct from policy achievability, runtime health, finding count or verified remediation.
Native service/finding identity and observed summary/detail. Do not require assessment FK; optional same-service capture correlation has an explicit basis.
Capture list/page/detail scope/outcomes and optional qualified assessment correlation. New incomplete capture cannot claim old complete coverage is current.
Capture/service/finding/representation plus exact field presence; preserve summary versus detail and incomplete hydration.

Locally identified suggested change anchored to exact finding-detail observation/category/ordinal, with its payload revision retained. Same content in another observation is not a native stable identity.

Separately versioned local title/estimate/complexity/planning overlay. Owner resolves a human, group or service assignee independently of the authenticated audit actor. Unknown cost stays unknown; enrichment cannot mutate original suggested changes.
Provider-managed status/count/time/message separate from strict ENABLED/DISABLED desired write. Missing output is unknown, not disabled.
Qualified service/dependency identity and DNS evidence; canonical relation/matches remain optional and sourced. No invented dependency-to-topology FK.
Independent local version, decision/rationale/actor/validity. It changes governance, not observed traffic, provider criticality or network permissions.
Immutable typed graph capture with filters/window/coverage. Resource/edge pages are not an atomic AWS snapshot.
Snapshot-local node identity and optional qualified Resource reference; unresolved endpoint is an explicit stub.
Both endpoints share snapshot; retain every supplied relation/label/type property and provenance. Missing type does not default to data flow.
Typed/scoped provider/canonical key with resolved/unresolved/tombstone state. This is a reference contract, not a universal untyped entity table.
Channel/stream scope/source event ID dedupe, raw envelope and independent source/receipt times. It is not an AWS HealthEvent.
Typed scoped subject/role/link evidence and parent scope; event arrival is refresh evidence, not a completed detail reconciliation.
Retain achievability and captured target context with explicit optional assessment correlation. Local finding disposition cannot rewrite posture.
Monitoring signal identity, measuredAt, expiry and source; independent of AWS HealthEvent and policy posture. Ties/older observations do not win by arrival.
Separate execution/posture/runtime health/discovery/coverage/attention; retain exact contributor IDs and rule version. Recompute does not renew source freshness.
Service-scoped source ID and exact typed configuration. Writes accept one supported union member; read-only MONITORING and unknown branches are not automatically creatable.
Service-local resourceIdentifier/full descriptor/input-source ref plus optional established canonical Resource identity. Unqualified ID is not a global resource.
Preserve service-scoped function references from findings and explicitly qualified resolution; no invented direct resource ARN.
Keep strict native write DTO separate from nullable observed configuration. Report destination is not artifact readiness; agentSpaceArn is a link, not identity equivalence.
Provider execution cost/billable units; never the local cost estimate of a proposed remediation.
Exact start/end/granularity and timestamped counts. DNS activity cannot become latency, request success or availability.
Bundle references the exact effective-target observation used by its context, not an independently selected current target set.
Explicit populations/counts, scope, freshness, reason codes and reducer version. Empty scope has no fabricated percentage or journey compliance.
Traversal infrastructure with principal/query/revision binding and expiry, not a business entity or native snapshot guarantee.
Concurrency/audit/history values preserve original identity; deleting local metadata does not cascade into retained snapshots or claim native deletion.
Field path/raw value/presence/reason preserve unknown output vocabulary and invalid/partial data without relaxing command inputs.
Deduplicate service contributors and keep separate runtime-health, policy-posture and assessment-coverage counts with scope, as-of time and reducer version.
